name: Chacha Chaudhary
summary: Pran's wise old man in a red turban, famous for a brain sharper than any computer. Created in 1971 for the Hindi magazine Lotpot and later a giant Diamond Comics hit.
origin: Cartoonist Pran created Chacha Chaudhary in 1971 for the children's magazine Lotpot. He drew on the strategist Chanakya and the wise elders found in every village, who solve problems with experience and humour. Chacha is an ordinary middle-class old man with no powers or gadgets, just a red turban, a wooden stick, a waistcoat and a very sharp mind. He lives with his wife Bini, his dog Rocket and Sabu, a giant from Jupiter who provides the muscle. Together they outwit corrupt officials, thieves, conmen and local thugs, who usually end up embarrassed.

storyline.title: Born in Lotpot
storyline.beat: Pran introduces the turbaned problem-solver in the Hindi magazine Lotpot.

storyline.title: Enter Sabu
storyline.beat: The giant Sabu from Jupiter visits Earth, tastes Chachi's parathas and halwa, and decides to stay as the family's strongman.

storyline.title: Raaka the unkillable
storyline.beat: Sabu's greatest enemy is Raaka, a giant made immortal by an Ayurvedic medicine. Sabu always wins but can only lock him away.

storyline.title: Live-action Chacha
storyline.beat: A live-action TV series casts Raghubir Yadav as Chacha Chaudhary.

storyline.title: Cartoon comeback
storyline.beat: Toonz Animation produces an animated Chacha Chaudhary TV series.

gossip.text: The comic has sold over ten million copies and appears in ten Indian languages.
According to the comics, a single meal for Sabu includes 202 chapatis and about 18 litres of lassi.
Whenever Sabu gets angry, a volcano erupts somewhere on Jupiter.
Chacha never locks his front door, yet nobody manages to rob his house.
Under the famous red turban, Chacha is completely bald.
Chacha Chaudhary is a superhero with powers.
gossip.truth: He has none. He wins with brains, a wooden stick and occasionally Sabu's muscles.

quiz.why: Sabu is a giant from Jupiter who chose to live with Chacha.

quiz.q: In which magazine did Chacha Chaudhary debut?
quiz.why: Pran created him for Lotpot in 1971.

quiz.q: What colour is Chacha Chaudhary's turban?
quiz.why: The red turban is his trademark.

theme.tagline: One turban, one stick, zero villains left standing.

timeline.title: Born in Lotpot
timeline.note: Pran introduces the turbaned old man who outthinks every crook, in the Hindi kids' magazine Lotpot.

timeline.title: Raghubir Yadav plays Chacha
timeline.note: A live-action series on Sahara One casts Raghubir Yadav and runs for 415 episodes.

timeline.title: Pran passes away
timeline.note: Creator Pran Kumar Sharma dies in August at 75, after more than four decades of Chacha strips.

timeline.title: Animated series
timeline.note: Toonz Animation's cartoon version premieres on Hungama TV and Disney Channel India.

timeline.title: Mascot for the Ganga
timeline.note: The Namami Gange clean-river mission picks Chacha Chaudhary as its mascot.
